newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline weakens with futures, UK budget talk.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline weakens with futures, UK budget talk.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were weaker on Tuesday. Traders attributed this partly to weaker futures and partly because of talk of a delay to the British budget.

Eurograde barges were heard offered as low as $209 a tonne fob ARA and news of a 14 percent cut in refinery crude oil throughput at Shell's 350,000 barrels per day (bpd) Rotterdam refinery, on top of BP and Texaco's run cuts last week, failed to provide enough lift to keep prices stable.
No business was heard concluded on the cargoes and arbitrage opportunities across the Atlantic were not thought workable.

British newspapers speculated over the long weekend that the new government's budget, which is expected to include an increase in gasoline taxes and has already led to some hoarding in advance of the possible tax hike, may be delayed by two or three weeks from the originally planned date of June 10.
Traders said they expected this to lead to an increase in short term selling with dealers unwilling to pay the extra costs of storage.
